company.name: BasharaCare
company.shortDescription: BasharaCare is an online retailer of skincare products targeted to consumers.
company.description:
BasharaCare is a Dubai-based online retailer that specialises in premium skincare, haircare, beauty, and grooming products. Founded in 2012, the company operates primarily as an e-commerce platform offering dermatologist-backed and clinically trusted beauty products to customers across the Middle East.
The platform provides a curated selection of professional skincare and cosmetic brands typically found in dermatology clinics, luxury spas, and pharmacies. BasharaCare focuses on high-performance products and innovations designed to address various skin and hair concerns such as aging, pigmentation, acne, and hair loss.
